script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS myt_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.plant_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.causation_id AS packing_id,
       CAST(j.create_user AS CHAR) AS create_user,
       j.request_payload,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_KPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       p.packing_no,
       p.packing_status,
       p.is_deleted,
       p.organization_id,
       CAST(p.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       CAST(p.so_id AS CHAR) AS so_id_json,
       CAST(p.customer_id AS CHAR) AS customer_id_json,
       p.packing_mode,
       p.packing_lock_session_id,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS gd_found,
       g.gd_status,
       g.delivery_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(g.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS delivery_date,
       CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS gd_plant_id,
       g.organization_id AS gd_org,
       (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR)
          FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
         WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.packingId}}
           AND h.is_deleted = 0) AS hu_n,
       (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CRC32(CONCAT_WS('|', h.id, COALESCE(h.hu_status, ''), COALESCE(h.temp_data, ''), COALESCE(h.handling_unit_id, ''), COALESCE(h.location_id, '')))), 0) AS CHAR)
          FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
         WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.packingId}}
           AND h.is_deleted = 0) AS hu_crc
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) o
  LEFT JOIN packing p
    ON p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.packingId}}
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.gd_id, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

       CAST(h.hu_quantity AS CHAR) AS hu_quantity,

       CAST(h.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,

       CAST(h.customer_id AS CHAR) AS customer_id_json,
       h.temp_data
  FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h

script.code:
SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       r.doc_type,
       r.status,
       r.parent_id,
       r.parent_line_id,
       r.parent_no,
       r.doc_no,
       r.doc_id,
       r.doc_line_id,
       CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       r.item_code,
       r.item_name,
       r.item_desc,
       CAST(r.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR) AS bin_location,
       CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR) AS item_uom,
       CAST(r.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(r.delivered_qty AS CHAR) AS delivered_qty,
       CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR) AS open_qty,
       CAST(r.line_no AS CHAR) AS line_no,
       r.remark,
       r.target_gd_id,
       r.source_reserved_id,
       r.handling_unit_id
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND r.target_gd_id = '{{node:code_node_KPentry.data.gdId}}'
   AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KPentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.plantId}}
   AND r.status = 'Allocated'
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY r.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR) AS based_uom,
       CAST(i.item_batch_management AS CHAR) AS item_batch_management,
       CAST(i.serial_number_management AS CHAR) AS serial_number_management,
       i.material_costing_method,
       CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR) AS purchase_unit_price,
       CAST(i.stock_control AS CHAR) AS stock_control,
       CAST(c.alt_uom_id AS CHAR) AS alt_uom_id,
       CAST(c.base_qty AS CHAR) AS base_qty
  FROM item i
  LEFT JOIN item_mji552rc_sub c
    ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND c.Item_id = i.id
   AND c.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT l.material_id
                  FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
                 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
                   AND l.goods_delivery_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.gdId}}
                   AND l.is_deleted = 0)
 ORDER BY i.id, c.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST('ITEM' AS CHAR) AS kind,
       CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       CAST('' AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(b.material_uom AS CHAR) AS material_uom,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS manufacturing_date,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS expired_date
  FROM item_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KPentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.plantId}}
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id) IN ({{node:code_node_KPplan1.data.itemTuplesSql}})
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('BATCH' AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.id AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.batch_id AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.material_uom AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR),
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR),
       CAST(DATE_FORMAT(b.manufacturing_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CHAR),
       CAST(DATE_FORMAT(b.expired_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CHAR)
  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KPentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_KPentry.data.plantId}}
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id) IN ({{node:code_node_KPplan1.data.batchTuplesSql}})
